# Base replay frame list of the eye chip start (public, user decision 2026-10-17; docs/EYE.md).
# The Windows cold-start list WITHOUT the two authentication steps (opcodes 0x76c and 0x777; the answer cannot be replayed)
# and WITH the developer's own calibration blob (step 26, opcode 0x456) as the built-in TEST calibration.
# Format: STEP n | class | description, then the exact URB(s). BULK_OUT ep=0x05: hex of the URB buffer incl. the 8-byte wrapper [u32 LE 0][u32 LE len-excl-wrapper].
# A TTP message > 4087 B is split into several URBs each with its own wrapper (4095 B buffers), as Windows does.
# Safety class: R=read-only, C=configures runtime state (repeated by Windows on every connect, same bytes), AUTH=needs live challenge, CAL=applies calibration blob (identical blob re-sent by Windows on every connect).

STEP 1 | R | standard: GET_DESCRIPTOR device(18), config(9 then 67), GET_STATUS, SET_CONFIGURATION(1) [bmRT 0x00 bReq 9 wValue 1], GET_DESCRIPTOR string idx3 (serial) - all as in transcript, no vendor writes

STEP 2 | C | CTRL OUT bmRT=0x41 bReq=48 wValue=0 wIndex=0 wLength=24 data=010000000000000001000000040000000000000000000000

STEP 3 | R | CTRL IN  bmRT=0xc1 bReq=48 wValue=0 wIndex=0 wLength=512 -> key=value text (fw version, platformtype XR5EYECHIP, subplatform XR5PIMAXDA)

STEP 4 | R | CTRL IN  bmRT=0xc1 bReq=70 wValue=1 wIndex=0 wLength=8 -> device time counter (Windows repeats ~20x during init; not needed)

STEP 5 | C | CTRL OUT bmRT=0x41 bReq=65 wValue=0 wIndex=0 wLength=0 (no data)
